# fshy: Developer services in full

> Monitoring, error tracking, analytics, scheduled jobs, queues, realtime and authentication services.

Data as of 2026-11-26, the date of the published data. Version `12288cc5e8c1`: the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of every record's Markdown, topic by topic in the one order (hosted before self-hosted, then verdict, provider name, record id); it changes whenever a record does.

This topic is 1,003 KB, about 271K tokens in full, more than the 300 KB, about 81K tokens one file holds, so it is split: its hosted records by verdict group, then its self-hosted records in one last group, and a group over that size into balanced parts. The parts in the order below are the one order (hosted before self-hosted, then verdict, provider name, record id). How to read a record: https://fshy.ajam.dev/llms-full.txt.
